5df86ca8: Loid Forger is Westalis's best spy, known by the codename Twilight.

Bond has visions of the future, which Anya can see by reading his thoughts.
c8c674bb: Yor Forger is a formidable assassin.
55b8c7bb: In the underworld, Yor is known as the Thorn Princess.
cc743422: By day, Yor is a clerk at Berlint City Hall.
96ca550a: For which organization does Yor eliminate her targets?

b3f8b541: Yuri is Yor's little brother: he adores her and is very wary of Loid.
fe37f83f: Which agency does Yuri work for?
Yuri belongs to Ostania's secret police, the very service that hunts spies like Twilight.
7797ad25: Who is Loid's superior, codenamed Handler?
Sylvia Sherwood runs Loid's operations within WISE.
f48ca268: Fiona Frost, alias Nightfall, is a WISE spy in love with Loid.
ce69aca2: What is the name of Loid's informant and friend?
Franky Franklin supplies Loid with information and gadgets, and falls in love all the time.
ee4bc6da: Anya loves peanuts and hates carrots.
ce6c0ee5: What does Anya keep saying when she gets excited?
“Waku waku” expresses her joyful excitement, especially whenever spies are involved.
6281c566: What is the name of the spy hero of Anya's favorite cartoon?
Anya loves Bondman, the hero of the cartoon Spy Wars.
84db2cf8: What is the name of Anya's beloved stuffed toy?
Anya never goes anywhere without her stuffed toy, Mr. Chimera.
bcbac2a0: Under which designation was Anya known at the laboratory?
Anya is Test Subject 007 of a secret experiment, the origin of her telepathy.
fc794b51: How old does Anya claim to be in order to enter Eden?
Anya says she is 6, the minimum age for Eden, even though she looks younger.
5e735dd7: Bond is a big white dog of the Great Pyrenees breed.
e6e6cf4f: Which secret program does Bond come from?
Bond was a test subject of Project Apple, which tried to create intelligent military animals.
1246ae49: How does Bond join the Forger family?
Yor finds him in the street
Anya adopts him after a mission against terrorists
Loid buys him at a pet shop
Bond is adopted after the plot to assassinate a minister, which his visions helped foil.
24549925: What is Yor's big weakness at home?
Yor is a disastrous cook, which leads to many gags.
774c6207: Which country does Loid spy for?
Loid works for Westalis, Ostania's neighbor and rival.
3c445ebd: Which intelligence agency does Loid work for?
cac4837d: What is the name of Loid's mission?
Operation Strix is the mission that forces Loid to build a fake family.
65207172: What is the goal of Operation Strix?
To get close to Donovan Desmond to preserve peace
Loid must get close to Donovan Desmond, who could reignite the war between the two countries.
47231096: The leader of Ostania's National Unity Party
Donovan Desmond leads the National Unity Party and almost never appears in public.
4813f174: Why does Loid need to start a family?
To enroll a child at Eden, Desmond's son's school
Desmond only appears at Eden events: so a child must be enrolled, and a family is needed to get them in.
a4cfb6aa: What is the name of the capital where the Forgers live?
Berlint is the capital of Ostania, an obvious nod to Berlin.
be213678: Why does Yor agree to marry Loid?
To avoid the suspicion her single status raises
Out of love at first sight
A single woman her age draws the secret police's attention: a marriage serves as her cover.
06bd4b36: Which member of the family knows everyone else's secrets?
Thanks to telepathy, Anya knows her father is a spy and her mother an assassin, but cannot tell anyone.
bf2548f8: Does Loid know that Yor is an assassin?

Loid knows nothing of Yor's double life, just as Yor knows nothing of his.
08f3c69f: Which historical conflict inspires the world of the series?
Ostania and Westalis echo the East and West of the Cold War.
3ddd40ac: During the cruise arc, who does Yor protect?
A woman and her baby targeted by killers
Yor escorts a mother and her baby who are being targeted aboard a luxury ship.
3e845642: What are the rewards given to deserving Eden students called?
Stella Stars reward remarkable deeds and results.
47471730: How many Stella Stars does it take to become an Imperial Scholar?
With eight Stella Stars, a student becomes an Imperial Scholar and gains access to the gatherings Donovan Desmond attends.
1ca00aa6: What are the penalties handed out at Eden called?
Tonitrus Bolts, shaped like lightning, punish serious misconduct.
ba2c46e9: How many Tonitrus Bolts get a student expelled from Eden?
Eight Tonitrus Bolts mean expulsion, which would end Operation Strix.
042a803f: Why does Anya get a Tonitrus Bolt on her very first day?
Anya punches Damian after he mocks her.
09dc4457: How does Anya earn her first Stella Star?
By saving a child from drowning
Anya senses through telepathy that a child has fallen into the river and helps save him.
67fcd2c9: What is the name of Donovan Desmond's son in Anya's class?
Damian Desmond is the key to Operation Strix: Anya has to become his friend.
bfc7498d: What is Damian's place in the Desmond family?
Damian is the second son. His older brother Demetrius is already an Imperial Scholar.
894ecf84: What is the name of Anya's best friend at Eden?
Becky Blackbell, the daughter of a wealthy family, takes to Anya right away.
b64619c9: Martha looks after Becky and turns out to be far more formidable than she looks.
3d6acee5: Which Eden teacher judges everything by its elegance?
Henry Henderson, the housemaster of Anya's dormitory, punctuates everything with an “Elegant!”.
f38c9029: Which Eden house are Anya and Damian in?
Anya, Damian and Becky belong to Cecile Hall.
15f59fe0: Bill Watkins, a real giant, is the dreaded opponent of the dodgeball episode.
484e3211: Who is the author of Spy × Family?
Tatsuya Endo created Spy × Family in 2019.
f8aae5c7: Spy × Family has been published online on Shōnen Jump+ since March 2019.
ca8ee6e7: Which studios produced the anime adaptation?
Wit Studio and CloverWorks co-produce the anime, which began in April 2022.
823fa3c0: Which band performs “Mixed Nuts”, the first opening theme?
“Mixed Nuts” is by Official Hige Dandism.
8dfbf6b0: Who performs “Kigeki”, the first ending theme?

93591ef3: What is the title of the film released in 2023?
